artifact_inventory.method: Inert ELF/Bun table extraction with bounds checks and content hashes; every extracted JavaScript module parsed with Acorn before candidate comparison. Shared bytecode regions are bounds-checked without repeatedly copying their contents.
artifact_inventory.limitation: Syntax/inventory coverage is not exhaustive semantic review or a native engine audit.

review.finding: Located 44 roles and 78 role/test bindings by lexical/AST candidates, then reviewed changed definitions, selected dependencies, public facade exports and actual component/CLI behavior. Similarity scores are not semantic approval.

The existing shared attribute builder adds anthropic.provider, anthropic.custom_base_url, and credential-dependent anthropic.plan / anthropic.seat_type. The custom-base-URL helper returns a boolean. Plan values and seat categories are mapped through finite sets. The event producer retains its async void contract and is replaced before enrichment and collector routing.
review.validation: A version-specific positive control requires anthropic.provider=firstParty and anthropic.custom_base_url=false in the original synthetic safety event. optional-off produces no record and performs zero payload getter reads. Account-dependent plan/seat branches were inspected statically, without real credentials.
review.boundary: The shared builder is also called by metric wrappers and tracing. Existing initializer, trace gates, no-op meter and nine exporter controls prevent the exercised optional exports; shared metric wrappers may still compute attributes locally. This is not a claim that every local getter or account-data read is eliminated.

review.finding: The telemetry module now caches proxy agents separately for HTTP and HTTPS, sets a tunnel-opening deadline from OTLP timeout settings (10 seconds by default, bounded at 30 seconds), and uses a specialized proxy agent. All nine tested exporter class contracts retain their normalized lexical shape. Producer/initializer and exporter replacements remain valid; the local transport positive/negative controls pass.
review.limitation: The component tests do not reproduce every new HTTPS proxy concurrency/timeout scenario from the upstream changelog.

review.finding: The streaming query function adds a second argument. The existing preparation wrapper forwards this and all other arguments via Reflect.apply, preserving the async iterator. Request construction adds a session-owner authorization condition; runner configuration can include an agent_proxy_url parameter. These original behaviors and the runner API object remain intact. No new business-header filtering was introduced.

The first-party initializer and event bindings retain their reviewed contracts; the original FetchSession-backed exporter still sends the explicit synthetic event in standard mode and not in optional-off. Both synchronous settings-application wrappers retain their contracts. Nine CLI request cases and six late settings reload cases pass, preserving tool timing, gateway hint behavior and unrelated settings.

acceptance.source_identity: Adapter 1.7.10 production profile and version-specific OTel component assertions; subsequent packaging changes only documentation and source manifest.

preserved: Native execution and Android DNS architecture
Settings reload protection and raw API-body controls
Official tool timing, gateway hints, permission decisions, shared feature gates and user settings
Artifact/module/Bun version checks, signed releases and process lease cleanup
limitations: Isolated configs, fake credentials, synthetic data and local receivers; no real account login or paid model calls.
Remote Control, real screen-reader hardware, fonts, actual TUN routing and long sessions were not tested.
Earlier binary profiles were retained unchanged and were not rerun in this update.
Known optional controls do not establish zero transmission, server-side privacy, account risk-scoring behavior or exhaustive native-path coverage.
